limitationTriage.limitation: The negative-axis count is eventual; no explicit threshold
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can explicit constants plus a finite computation give the count for every n?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: assessed by the lead: needs explicit constants in every o(1) of Lemmas 2-5 and certified checks up to a threshold likely in the thousands
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: beyond a cheap computation; exact check up to n = 24 recorded

limitationTriage.limitation: The limit law omits an arc of 1/30 of the circle around q = 1
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Does an analytic argument cover theta -> 0?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: numerics suggest the smallest zero stays simple; each fixed arc is a finite certificate
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: the problem passes into the connectivity window of the real random graph

limitationTriage.limitation: Whether every nontrivial zero lies in the open unit disk
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Does a known result settle Buys Question 4.1 for K_n?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: literature checked: equivalent to a conjecture of Sokal; open

limitationTriage.limitation: The arc result first covered only 6/7 of the circle
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can the certificate be extended cheaply?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: yes: check_arc_extension.py, twelve sub-arcs down to pi/30

limitationTriage.limitation: The finite-size formula hid a term of the same order
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: yes: cubic term from Waldvogel's expansion; Table 2
